Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-2445-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-2445-5254.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

2034-2073-3698-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Elven Bow trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent

When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-6991-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Donnie & April
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.

Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

874-876-1170-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-876-1170-1329.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1402-1753-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2468-3094-3980.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Sisay's Ring and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

46-1357-4697.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
46-1357-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
46-1357-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

974-1305-2645-4417-6674.description:

Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}{B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Rydia.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Great Train Heist without paying its mana cost, and choosing to pay an additional {2}{R} to select its first mode, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

394-856-4321-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

Repeat from step 3.
